statement: Two smooth equivariant lifts of the same orbit map on Xc have the same smooth mapping class; quotient isotopies compactly supported in the free stratum lift.
depends_on: C.3.1;C.3.2;direct normal-slice Taylor and flat-division argument
notes: Does not isotope the annular gamma twist or compute its invariant. Original non-equivariant Haefliger-Salem Lemma3.2 corrected; no unproved quotient smoothness used.
